# UD Hasse current/curl audit 0.1

Development — no registry entry. Independent review pending. Physical promotion 0.

Read UD_HASSE_CURRENT_CURL_AUDIT_v0.1.html or source/HASSE_CURRENT_CURL_AUDIT.md.

Run `python3 replay/verify_hasse_current_curl.py` for exact checks. Python 3 and SymPy are required. `python3 replay/build_release.py` also requires lxml and Pandoc and recreates the HTML and ZIP.

The six finite carriers have complete integer matrices in audit/MATRICES.json. The receipt includes exact ranks, unit Smith invariants, rational current decomposition, two normalized dynamic witnesses, ownership checks and matched/mismatched metrics. It does not derive Maxwell equations, native source terms, coarse recursive support, a physical metric or electric charge. Attached ledger and governance are preserved. Missing Gap2_FINAL_Finite_Genesis.png was not used.
